captions.caption: A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively climbing and shifting its position among the branches. It pauses to look around, then raises its head and opens its mouth as if vocalizing or reacting to something, all while surrounded by fresh green blossoms with buildings visible in the background.

A brown bear is perched high in a tree with light green blossoms, actively foraging by tearing at and eating the bark or inner layers of a branch. The bear shifts its position slightly, looking around and down, while the urban backdrop of a building remains visible through the branches.

A brown bear is perched high in a flowering tree, its body nestled among the branches. It appears to be foraging, initially looking down and then lifting its head to survey its surroundings. The bear's powerful limbs grip the branches as it shifts its weight, showcasing its agility in the urban environment, with a building visible in the background.

A brown bear is perched high in a tree with fresh green blossoms, actively feeding on the buds. It uses its paws to grip branches and pull at the foliage, its head tilted upward as it eats, with a building visible in the background.

A large brown bear is perched among the branches of a tree with fresh green blossoms, actively eating the flowers or buds. The bear stands upright on its hind legs, using its front paws to hold onto branches as it feeds. In the background, a multi-story building is visible, indicating the scene takes place in an urban or suburban environment.

A brown bear is actively climbing through the branches of a leafy tree, its powerful body and paws gripping the limbs as it navigates the foliage. The scene is set in an urban environment, with buildings visible in the background, creating a striking contrast between the wild animal and the man-made surroundings. The bear appears focused on its ascent, moving deliberately through the greenery.
A large brown bear is seen climbing and resting among the branches of a leafy tree, with a building visible in the background.

A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively foraging by pulling down and eating the green, catkin-like blossoms. The bear is seen in various positions as it moves among the branches, with a building and a river visible in the background, indicating an urban or semi-urban environment.
A brown bear is seen actively climbing and maneuvering through the branches of a leafy tree near a river, with a building visible in the background.

Two bears are seen climbing and maneuvering through the branches of a leafy tree near a river, with one bear actively climbing up while the other remains partially obscured, both appearing to be engaged in a dynamic, tree-based activity.
A family of brown bears is actively climbing a leafy tree near a body of water, with cubs scrambling up the trunk and branches while an adult bear is perched higher up, all observed by people below.
Three brown bears are actively climbing a leafy tree near a river, with one bear positioned high up and the others lower down, while a crowd of onlookers watches from a viewing platform below.

Two young brown bears are seen climbing a tree trunk in a zoo or wildlife park, with one bear positioned higher than the other. Below them, a glass-bottomed walkway allows visitors to observe the animals, and their reflections are visible in the calm water beneath. The scene takes place on a sunny day with lush green foliage, capturing the bears' natural climbing behavior as they ascend the tree.

Two young brown bears interact near a tree trunk in a grassy enclosure beside a calm body of water; one climbs the tree while the other sits at its base, and they eventually meet and nuzzle each other.

Two young brown bears are seen in a grassy, wooded area, initially huddled together near a tree trunk. The larger bear remains mostly stationary while the smaller one moves around it, eventually walking away as the larger bear begins to follow.
Two bears, an adult and a cub, walk together across a grassy, wooded area, moving steadily from left to right and gradually exiting the frame.
